about.title: AI solutions built by digital marketing experts.
about.description1: Aiva was founded by digital marketing experts who spent years building campaigns, content, and online sales systems for a variety of companies. Through our work with clients, we saw how much time and resources businesses were losing to repetitive marketing and operational tasks.
about.description2: So we started building AI systems that automate content, communication, and operational processes, so businesses can work faster and more efficiently. Today we help companies implement AI solutions that boost productivity, optimize marketing, and enable business scaling.
about.principlesTitle: How we think, how we work.

principles.title: Results over demos
principles.description: We measure success in time saved, revenue generated, and errors eliminated, not impressive prototype videos.

principles.title: Honesty over hype
principles.description: We'll tell you when AI isn't the right answer. Our reputation is worth more than any single oversold engagement.

principles.title: Craft at every layer
principles.description: From system architecture to the user interface, we hold ourselves to a standard that makes us genuinely proud of our work.

principles.title: Long-term partnerships
principles.description: We design every system so you can own it. Our goal is to be the last AI partner you need, not to create dependency.

about.teamTitle: Small on purpose. Obsessive by nature.
about.teamDescription: We keep the team compact so every project gets senior-level attention. No juniors handing off your work at the end of a sprint.
about.toolingDescription: Model-agnostic. Pragmatic. Always the right tool for the job.
